name: Melea
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Melea is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke. He is the son of Menna and the father of Eljakim, and is part of the long lineage connecting King David with Jesus Christ. Little is known about his life beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Melea is mentioned as part of Jesus' lineage in the Gospel of Luke, as the son of Menna and father of Eljakim.

keyEvents.title: Part of the lineage from David
keyEvents.description: Melea is part of the lineage that goes through David's son Nathan and ultimately leads to Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Connection to God's plan of salvation
keyEvents.description: Through his place in the genealogy, Melea is part of the unbroken line that fulfills God's promise of a Messiah from David's lineage.

keyEvents.title: God's promise to David of an eternal throne
keyEvents.description: Melea is part of the family line that carries forward God's covenant promise to David that his throne would endure forever.
